description:
Find advertisers in the Google Ads Transparency Center (Google Search, YouTube,
        Display, Shopping, Maps, Play) by name. Use it to get the advertiser_id (AR...) needed by
        search_google_ads and get_google_ad.

        Cost: 1 credit per call, whatever the number of advertisers returned (none found too);
        an error costs 0.

        Args:
            query: Advertiser (company) name.
            limit: 1-10 (default 10).
name: search_google_advertisers
title: Search Google advertisers
